# IssueLens operational reporting
Schema v1, Application Insights customEvents. These assets are checked offline, not live-import/query validated. Select the intended Applications resource. Unknown usage is not zero; transport completion and HTTP success are not business success. Facts must be unsampled but are not lossless or an audit ledger. Facts use an isolated, trace-independent context and explicit run_trace_id. Host enrichment and trace-based log sampling are tested offline; live ingestion settings and delivery still need verification. Diagnostic traces may be sampled. Native per-call CLI trace export is not enabled.

Blank filters mean all. A target number requires both repository and kind (issue, pull_request or unresolved work_item; repository/wiki use 0). Target filters select whole runs, including all their other targets, without allocating tokens. Clear target filters when investigating missing telemetry. Copy a run ID into RunId for agent and native request-trace details. See docs/observability.md and observability/queries.kql in the repository.

## Overview
Terminal records include failed/cancelled runs; rejected admissions are separate. Transport, execution and business outcomes are independent. Token sums use root terminal facts once, with known-record samples and per-call field coverage. Cache/reasoning breakdowns are not additive to input/output. No pricing or cost estimate is implemented. Target counts are exact observed typed identities; relationships and any_repository overlap and must not be added.

content.json:
## Run explorer
Copy a run_id into RunId. The lifecycle grid is limited to the latest 100 rows; detail grids are bounded. Missing start/terminal can be a window boundary, active run, ingestion delay or loss. Agent usage is exclusive and must not be added to root/model totals; duration_s is captured at observed execution end. Missing events can still prevent full attribution. model_request_sent describes host dispatch, not proof of provider acceptance or a count of API calls.

Host issue-image reads initially use work_item. A later typed SDK issue/PR result merges pending unknown associations before export. Successful issuelens-config calls count as repository reads. Optional repository_id comes from observed get_repository results, with no enrichment-only reads. Tool attempts do not identify primary user intent. Successful operations do not necessarily change state; notification submission is not delivery.

Retained request traces match operation_Id to explicit run_trace_id and provide native Details links, not native per-call CLI export. No matching request does not mean no trace: inspect dependencies, sampling, time range and correlation. Links and ingestion need validation on the target resource. No message, URL or exception content is selected.

## Reliability and performance
Percentiles use known samples only; missing first output remains null. First root output and first final-phase text are host-observed timings, not model TTFT or client latency. First final output is not full-answer completion. No alert threshold or SLO is asserted. Model facts aggregate once per run/model; do not add these totals to the root usage report. Error categories count affected runs, not attempts, and do not replace execution/business outcomes.

content.json:
## Telemetry quality
Clear target filters, broaden the time range and allow for ingestion before diagnosing missing starts/completions. Active runs and window boundaries are not automatically failures or loss. Admission rejections do not require starts. Null completeness/ownership/model-dispatch flags remain unknown, not false. Missing and explicitly unknown transport status are separate. Compare the token-field coverage in Overview as well as usage_status. attribution_complete=true does not prove every event was retained.

The bounded-state table contains only reported incomplete_* counters; absence is not proof of no drops. A lost final fact cannot report its own export failure. Ingestion lag is measured on the latest logical lifecycle fact, excludes negative samples from percentiles and shows coverage. Neither unsampled facts nor these checks make Application Insights an audit ledger.
